task_criteria: Admission predicate from the original local CF-007 review: inspect scripts/disk-policy.py and scripts/project-node.sh; floor parsing and df observations fail closed even at zero, compare exact thresholds without display rounding, and reject invalid/low disk before state creation, adapter installation, clone or manifest. Execute python3 -B tests/disk-contract.py DiskContract synchronously; its 15 tests must pass including boundary and malformed cases and its exact refusal-removal behavioral mutant. This grades committed local code, not live capacity.

Reclamation predicate from the original local CF-007 review: inspect scripts/disk-policy.py, lib.sh, project-node.sh and tests/disk-contract.py. Only explicit apply opt-in may delete enrolled flat disposable blobs; check never reclaims. Unsafe paths/types/links/permissions/lock contention fail closed, outside/durable sentinels survive, remeasurement gates admission, and repetition is idempotent. Run focused tests synchronously, never background a suite or use broad pgrep polls. Existing 15-test DiskContract covers these predicates and the staging copy-failure control.

Integration, scope and trace predicate from the original local CF-007 review: run timeout 110 bash tests/selftest.sh synchronously and require rc0 SELFTEST PASS; do not background or pgrep-poll it. NODE.md and DESIGN.md accurately mark 5GiB provisional, no runtime quota, historical footprints and unauthorized live orphan/role-sizing obligations as still open. Resolve board CF-007, spec Laws section, DiskContract and docs/audits/code-factory-CF-007-152022-worker.md plus -foreman.md as the prior committed trace; explicit witness none is correct and no self-referential final verdict/SHA is required.
